decisions.reason: It fits closely with the established modular sensing platform and its stronger 2024 presentation suggests enough investment and public commitment that management would continue rather than reverse course.
This industrial input module is highly consistent with the firm's core automation offer and was visibly promoted across both years, making continued support the escalatory choice.
Although less prominently marketed, it is a close extension of the existing control portfolio, so sunk development and the logic of offering a complete building-block system favor retaining it.
As a very recent launch on the established platform, any weak uptake can still be interpreted as temporary while prior engineering effort and portfolio breadth argue against an early withdrawal.
The remote access service supports the firm's stated expansion in charging and energy management, so its strategic centrality and recent investment make continued commitment especially likely.
